dialogue_texts: This has made me work harder than usual...
At least the glohm is what you've been looking for...
Listen to me, Your Honor. There could be one final shard to this incident.
I think the glohm experiment must have started in the Scarlet Devil Mansion.
Based on everything I've heard on the way here, it had to be the Order's responsibility.
I cannot allow this to happen again, so please go there if you can.
There will always be another... an origin world creating cursed tools. An incident can't just be a simple monster hunt for once.
You must be all tired from that fighting, Your Honor. I can give you a night in the mansion to rest up.
I simply have no more energy to return home to the Hakurei Shrine. I'll leave it up to Aya to tell your partner that things have been resolved.
I'm glad you're staying because do you want to witness something spectacular?
We have to wait until the sun sets, which won't be until a few hours.
The sun's disc is almost past the horizon. Wait for it...
Whoa... that's quite a change. You look a lot less like a maid and now a formal host.
Night is where my true strength lies. This was the reason my partner and I got close. Our first dance clearly showed we'd be together.
Your partner's back at the Hakurei Shrine, and I'd like to see you two waltz.
I wish I could, but when he's not present, I feel lonely like a princess in a tower.
It sure does get quiet here... no spirits or frantic calls for help - just the wind. Maybe staying one night isn't the worst idea.
Rest then, Your Honor. Tomorrow's world will still be there, and everything we've been through today will be nothing more than a bad dream.
I hope things won't get too embarrassing...
With that curse lifted, the sun has set on a peaceful horizon, and our long day has finally come to an end.
Congratulations! Good ending! Tomorrow on the agenda is the Scarlet Devil Mansion, where the Extra Stage awaits.
